body.statement: There exist universal constants \(0<c<C<\infty\) such that for every sequence with \(d_n\to\infty\), \(d_n=o(\sqrt n)\), and \(nd_n\) even, \[\Pr_{G_n}\!\left\{c\,r_{\log}(n,d_n)\le R_2(G_n)\le C\,r_{\log}(n,d_n)\right\}\longrightarrow1.\] On the same graph event, the design-estimator returned by \(\mathsf{Compile}(G_n)\) has worst-case design MSE at most \(C\,r_{\log}(n,d_n)\) over exactly \(\mathcal M(G_n,\tau_{\mathrm{GATE}},2)\).
body.justification: This field-tier closure identifies the universal risk scale and certifies an attaining one-shot procedure against the unrestricted Kandiros--Harshaw--S\'{a}vje benchmark.
body.gap: KandirosHarshawSavje2026Minimax Corollary 5.4 leaves a factor \(d_n\) on the identical game; the inherited version-one infrastructure narrows this to a logarithmic gap, and the sole new root-level four-root estimate closes that remaining gap.
body.consumer: KarrerEtAl2021Scale can use the theorem to determine whether the deployed cluster-randomized \(d_n^2/n\) benchmark is rate-optimal in the diffuse regular-network regime and how required population size grows with degree.

obligation.what_is_open:
The high-probability logarithmic upper edge, and hence the matched
two-sided frontier, remain open because the dense Boolean operator event
has not been proved.
obligation.obstruction:
The unrestricted all-procedure lower edge is proved, and the seed estimator
is a total observed-data procedure whose risk is at most
\(C r_{\log}(n,d_n)\) on the Boolean operator event.  The unresolved dense
graph event is therefore the only missing implication in this proof spine.
It cannot be inserted as a hypothesis without assuming the paper's stated
kernel.
obligation.attempted:
The lower Bayes prior, balanced-hole switching bound, exact seed
Rao--Blackwellization, Schur covariance calculation, tuning algebra, and
finite compiler were all audited.  The exact eight-vertex test supports
the fourth-trace algebra but does not establish its asymptotic signed
cancellation.  The weaker deterministic covariance route still requires
centered radius-two control and does not presently yield an independent
dense certificate.
obligation.partial_result:
There is a universal \(c>0\) such that
\[
\Pr\{R_2(G_n)\ge c r_{\log}(n,d_n)\}\to1.
\]
Moreover, on every sufficiently large graph satisfying
\(\|B_GP_n\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le Ld_n^{7/4}\), the explicit seed design and
observed-data estimator have worst-case MSE at most
\(C r_{\log}(n,d_n)\), and the finite compiler implements this procedure
with the stated exhaustive cost.  The graph event is proved when
\(d_n\le n^{2/5}\); only its dense-range probability is unresolved.
